{{Quote|Give up! You're a prisoner of the mimphs!|Masher|<ref name="GWTM" />}}
'''Masher''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[mimph]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he led a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] team that captured the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who was unconscious due to a fight he had had with a beast known as a [[hanadak]]. Masher and his team brought Warrick to their [[Mimph village|village]], which was later attacked by the hanadak. In the struggle to defeat the beast, Warrick saved Masher's life, as well as the lives of the other team members. As a reward, Masher offered the Ewok a [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]] lost by his mimph comrade, [[Thrasher (mimph)|Thrasher]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're taking you back to our village!|Masher|<ref name="GWTM" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[mimph]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], Masher lived in a [[Mimph village|village]] constructed near a [[Unidentified Endor river (mimph village)|river]] not far from the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="GWTM" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of Masher|[[Gone With the Mimphs]]}}</ref> Masher led a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] team to the river, where they came across the Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who had fallen unconscious after battling a beast called a [[hanadak]]. While the Ewok slept, Masher and his teammates, including [[Smasher]], [[Thrasher (mimph)|Thrasher]], and another [[Unidentified mimph|mimph]], bound him in [[Rope/Legends|rope]] and placed him on a wheeled vehicle. When Warrick awoke, Masher and the others dragged him back to their [[City/Legends|village]], where they hid him behind a curtain as other mimphs from the village gathered to watch.<ref name="GWTM" />

When the curtain was drawn and Warrick was revealed, Masher asked the Ewok to roar for the crowd. Instead, Warrick mumbled the [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] expletive "kvark" to himself. The excited mimphs loudly repeated the word, drawing the attention of the nearby hanadak, which tore through the village and destroyed several mimph homes and buildings. In the hopes of stopping the creature, Masher ordered his team to attack and leaped onto its gargantuan leg with his comrades. The beast, however, showed no sign of slowing down, and merely swatted the diminutive mimphs away.<ref name="GWTM" />

Warrick, concerned for the mimphs' safety, tore free of his bonds and safely caught the mimphs before they hit the ground. He then used the curtain to blindfold the hanadak, which fell into the river. Warrick was dismayed over having missed an opportunity to acquire a hanadak [[Tooth/Legends|fang]] for his [[Belt of Honor]], so, after quietly consulting with his comrades, the grateful Masher offered Warrick a mimph tooth, which Thrasher had lost in a fight.<ref name="GWTM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Please, take this gift.''"<br />"''What is it?''"<br />"''A mimph tooth for your belt of honor! Thrasher lost it in a fight.|Masher and Wicket|<ref name="GWTM" />}}
Like most mimphs, Masher was small&mdash;significantly shorter than 0.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="SWE" />&mdash;with [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black pupils, and pink and pale [[Hair/Legends|fur]], including a small patch of white fur growing on his chin. Like many mimphs, Masher wore a red cap, although it differed in having two small, white horns protruding from the top.<ref name="GWTM" />

Courageous despite his small stature, Masher was proud in the face of danger, showing no fear in capturing creatures much larger than himself, and not hesitating to defend his village against the monstrous hanadak. He was concerned with the impressions of others, and he hoped to impress the mimph village by convincing the captured Warrick to roar. However, he was also quite amiable, as was shown when he offered Warrick a mimph tooth as a trophy after the young Ewok saved his life.<ref name="GWTM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MasherCel.jpg|thumb|right|An animation celluloid from "Gone With the Mimphs" reveals Masher's name.]]
Masher first appeared in "[[Gone With the Mimphs]],"<ref name="GWTM" /> the ninth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series. "Gone With the Mimphs," written by [[Linda Woolverton]], originally aired on [[October 18]], [[1986]].<ref name="CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> While he was not named in the episode, an animation celluloid from the episode revealed Masher's name.
